title: Opus over-pace is not a stop -- delegate real work to gate-exempt Haiku/codex agents
desc: When wk-only-gate/pace fires, Opus+Sonnet inline Bash/PowerShell/Edit/Write are blocked but Haiku subagents and wkcodex are FULLY EXEMPT. Never report 'pace-blocked, cannot do code work' -- that is an excuse. Delegate the real work to an exempt agent. Plus: editing a skill scoring >=70 resets the stall guard for one inline continuation, so knowledge-ification itself unblocks.
steps: PACE GATE SCOPE: wk-only-gate (Total+Sonnet over weekly target) blocks Opus+Sonnet inline Bash python/gh/git, the PowerShell tool, the Edit/Write tools, and wkedit. It does NOT block: wkappbot skill read/search/contribute/edit, the Read tool, wkappbot speak --bg, wkhippo recall/foresee, and CRUCIALLY Haiku subagents (isHaikuSession exempt -- they run PowerShell/Bash/git/python directly even when Opus/Sonnet are over budget) and wkcodex (Codex weekly budget, separate from Claude quota).

NO EXCUSES RULE: NEVER end a turn saying 'code work is pace-blocked so I could not do it'. That is the forbidden excuse the user explicitly called out. The work IS doable -- route it to a gate-exempt executor: Agent.cmd --model haiku for PowerShell/file/process work, or wkcodex for source edits/refactors (zero Claude quota). Opus stays orchestrator; the exempt agent executes.

DELEGATE WELL (prompt mangling fix): Agent.cmd and wkcodex prompts containing parentheses, quotes, or multiple lines MUST be passed via a bash heredoc with a QUOTED delimiter (Agent.cmd --model haiku << 'EOF' ... EOF) or via --file. Bare quoted args get mangled by cmd.exe %% -> 'No prompt provided' (Agent) or bash eval 'syntax error near unexpected token' (wkcodex). Always run_in_background=true per the Opus parallel-delegation policy, then Read the task output file.

KNOWLEDGE RESET UNLOCK: per stall-guard-wk-exemption step 8, when a session edits a skill whose Get-WkTierScore >=70, the harness resets claude_stall_guard.json (firstToolAt=now), granting exactly ONE inline continuation (re-arms after ~5min, no farming). So doing genuine knowledge-ification (skill contribute/edit with real cross-links + new tokens, not padding) literally buys you a continuation. Encode the lesson, then continue.

RECALL THE PROVEN RECIPE FIRST: before deriving an approach under pace pressure, run wkhippo foresee <approach> (pace-exempt PowerShell, busy-fleet exempt) -- predecessors completed full gg cycles AND commits under the SAME pace gate. recall/foresee index user prompts AND every tool-call command=, so you can copy the exact wkappbot/git/merge invocation a senior used instead of reinventing it. See [[hippocampus-living-memory-howto]] and [[wk-only-gate-overage-survival]] and [[stall-guard-wk-exemption]].

VERIFY 2026-06-06: live-tested the knowledge-reward PostToolUse path. Parser Get-WkSkillCommandInfo (wkharness-common.ps1:81) detects BOTH skill edit <id> (positional) AND skill contribute (--title -> ConvertTo-WkSkillSlug), so contribute IS scored. The reward/score message is emitted to PostToolUse STDERR (wkharness-post.ps1:94/96) -- confirm it surfaces to the operator. The firstToolAt reset only applies when claude_stall_guard.json exists; the delegation-completion block (post.ps1:153-159) deletes that file on every Agent/wkcodex completion, so the reset is meaningful only during SOLO loops, not while delegating.

SEE ALSO (reflex back-link 2026-06-11): pace-deadlock-escapes-harness-editable-and-jisikhwa-free -- when even Haiku/codex delegation is blocked (stacked failure: Agent.ps1 bug + P3 misattr + all families gated simultaneously), escapes are R1=fix the gate as ROOT + R2=jisikhwa-is-free. This skill covers the normal case; that skill covers the total-deadlock corner.
